messages:
marta: quick heads up — I noticed two dead links in the 429 troubleshooting runbook after the tech writers merge last night. The examples section also references an old SDK retry header that's gone.

alex: thanks. which links? paste them here and i'll take a look :eyes:

marta: right here:
- https://docs.redwood.ai/errref/429-legacy -> 404
- https://internal.redwood.ai/snippets/legacy-retry -> 404
Also the snippet in the 'client-resilience' block shows `Retry-After` usage like this:

```
headers = {"Retry-After": "5"}
client.generate(..., headers=headers)
```

but our SDK now takes `retry_policy` object, not raw headers.

sam: yep, SDK changed in 2025-11. The new example should be:

```
from redwood import RetryPolicy, Client
rp = RetryPolicy(max_retries=3, backoff_factor=0.5)
client = Client(retry_policy=rp)
client.generate(...)
```

jen: i'll open a small docs PR to fix links + swap snippet. assigning to @alex for review. want to keep example minimal — no more than 6 lines.

alex: +1. also add a one-liner note about server 429 vs client-side throttling and link to the rate-limit playbook.

marta: added a suggested sentence: "429s can be from global rate limits or per-customer quotas — prefer exponential backoff and a short jitter; fall back to a cheaper model variant when available."

docs-bot: [automated] docs issue #472 linked to this thread; suggested assignees: jen, alex

jen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1892 — small edits, fixed both links, replaced snippet, added note + cross-link to rate-limit playbook.

alex: quick review done, left one nit re: wording of jitter. LGTM after that.

jen: addressed nit, pushed force-push.

alex: merging now, will monitor site build. thanks everyone :tada:

marta: thanks! once live i'll update the troubleshooting checklist and add the new snippet to the SDK migration appendix.

sam: FYI, i'll file a short changelog entry for the SDK team so they can reference the new example in release notes.

marta: perfect — closing this thread when the site live check passes.

jen: site build succeeded, links verified on prod. closing thread.
